query: Which per-class precision/recall/F1 and confidence-calibration targets will we monitor, and what stopping criteria will govern active-learning sampling?

response.query: Which per-class precision/recall/F1 and confidence-calibration targets will we monitor, and what stopping criteria will govern active-learning sampling?
response.answer: We monitor per-class precision, recall, F1 score, and confidence calibration. Active-learning sampling stops when the F1 score plateaus or when a predefined budget is reached.
